shipping.source: Shopify Shipping label costs from ShopifyQL (FROM shipping_labels)

notes.shopify_plan_monthly: Grow plan list price on monthly billing ($79/mo if billed annually). Edit to match your Shopify invoice.
notes.shopify_apps_monthly: Recurring app charges from Settings > Billing. Not exposed by the Admin API, so enter manually.

cogs.note: Landed cost per unit (product + freight to USA) from the Roofus master sheet (data/product_costs.csv), matched to Shopify product titles (regex, first match wins). Bundles carry their full cost, gifts included: Buy 1 Get 1 = 2 canisters ($2.52); Buy 2 Get 2 = 4 canisters + poop bags ($5.04 + $1.19); Buy 3 Get 3 = 6 canisters + poop bags + paw cleanser ($7.56 + $1.19 + $0.82). Gift line items are $0 so they aren't counted twice. Faire wholesale items that aren't linked to a Shopify product are costed by SKU from data/raw/faire_orders.json.
